latest.title: Nonexistence of complete metrics with uniformly positive scalar curvature
latest.abstract: Let $X$ be a connected oriented even-dimensional manifold whose universal cover is spin. We prove that $X$ admits no complete metric with uniformly positive scalar curvature when either infinite relative $K$-area or a relative cohomological condition holds along compact sets escaping to infinity in a fixed open subset with compact complement. The proof compares twisted Dirac operators on spin covers of compact manifolds with boundary and combines a heat-kernel argument on fundamental domains with a long-neck estimate.
latest.workSummary: 对普遍覆盖 spin 的偶维定向流形，给出排除完备一致正标量曲率度量的相对 K 面积与上同调条件。
latest.breakthrough: 把紧集逃向无穷远的相对拓扑信息转化为标量曲率障碍。
latest.limitations: 排除一致正并不等于排除处处正；spin 覆盖与逃逸紧集条件不可省略。 已补读相关引言或主结果片段，尚未逐行验证完整证明。
latest.aiEvidence: 用 ChatGPT、Claude 辅助检索、探索与符号计算；附录 B 的 Bass–Serre 方法由模型建议。
latest.priorityReason: 标量曲率和非紧几何拓扑障碍相关性强。
